metadata.description: Produce a view-mode-projected explanation of an ABE AssessmentResult (non-diagnostic, synthetic-data DEV_TEST runtime only). view_mode is restricted to GUARDIAN or REVIEWER; GUARDIAN view redacts internal numeric estimates server-side — no guardian-facing numeric disease probability is ever exposed.
